messages.content: How can I sell my acoustic guitar?

function.name: tune_instrument
function.description: This function helps tune instruments based on the instrument type and the desired key or note. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

instrument_type.description: The type of the instrument, e.g. 'acoustic guitar', 'piano'.

key.description: The key or note to which the instrument should be tuned to. Default is 'Standard' for guitars.

message.content:
Here’s a quick, step‑by‑step guide to help you get your acoustic guitar sold quickly and for a fair price: | Step | What to Do | Why It Matters | |------|------------|----------------| | **1. Clean & Tune** | Give the guitar a thorough cleaning (strings, fretboard, body). Tune it to standard pitch. | A well‑presented instrument looks more appealing and shows you’ve cared for it. | | **2. Take Quality Photos** | Capture the whole body, headstock, strings, fretboard, and any imperfections. Use natural light and a neutral background. | Good photos attract buyers and reduce the chance of disputes over condition. | | **3. Research Market Value** | Check recent sales on Reverb, eBay, Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace, and local classifieds. Note prices for similar models, ages, and conditions. | Helps you set a realistic asking price and avoid underselling. | | **4. Write a Clear Listing** | Include:
• Brand, model, year, serial number (if known)
• Condition (new, like new, used, any damage)
• Features (pickguard, inlay, electronics)
• Reason for selling
• Price (fixed or “best offer”)
• Shipping options (if applicable) | Transparency builds trust and speeds up the sale. | | **5. Choose Your Platforms** | • **Reverb** – great for musical instruments, buyer protection.
• **eBay** – broad audience, auction or fixed price.
• **Craigslist / Facebook Marketplace** – local, no shipping needed.
• **Local music stores** – consignment or direct purchase.
• **Pawn shops** – quick cash, but usually lower offers. | Different platforms reach different buyer types; use a mix for maximum exposure. | | **6. Set a Competitive Price** | Start slightly above your target price if you’re open to negotiation. If you’re in a hurry, price closer to your minimum acceptable amount. | Gives room for bargaining while still meeting your goal. | | **7. Handle Payment Safely** | • For local sales: meet in a public place, accept cash or Venmo/PayPal (with buyer protection).
• For online sales: use PayPal Goods & Services or eBay’s payment system. Avoid wire transfers or personal checks. | Protects you from fraud and ensures you receive payment. | | **8. Ship (if needed)** | • Pack the guitar in a padded case or a sturdy box with foam inserts.
• Use a reputable carrier (UPS, FedEx, USPS) and insure the shipment.
• Provide tracking info to the buyer. | Reduces risk of damage and gives both parties peace of mind. | | **9. Close the Sale** | Once payment is confirmed, ship the guitar promptly. Send the tracking number and keep a copy of the receipt. | Builds a good reputation and may lead to positive feedback or referrals. | | **10. Keep Records** | Save invoices, shipping receipts, and any correspondence. | Useful for tax purposes and in case of disputes. | ### Quick Tips - **Be Honest About Condition** – Buyers appreciate transparency; it reduces returns and disputes. - **Offer Extras** – If you have extra strings, a strap, or a case, mention them. They can justify a higher price. - **Respond Promptly** – Quick replies increase buyer confidence. - **Use “Best Offer” Wisely** – If you’re flexible, let buyers make offers; just set a floor price you won’t go below. ### Example Listing (Reverb) ``` Title: 2008 Yamaha FG800 Acoustic Guitar – Excellent Condition Description: - Brand: Yamaha - Model: FG800 - Year: 2008 - Condition: Like new – no scratches, no cracks, strings replaced last month. - Features: Solid spruce top, mahogany back & sides, rosewood fingerboard, 12‑string pickup. - Reason for selling: Upgrading to a 12‑string model. - Price: $650 (fixed) - Shipping: Free shipping within the U.S. (insured, tracked). Photos: [Attach 8–10 high‑resolution images] ``` Feel free to adapt this template to your own guitar’s specifics. Good luck with your sale!

We can provide steps: research market value, clean instrument, take photos, list on platforms (eBay, Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace, Reverb), set price, describe condition, shipping options, safety tips.
